extraction_warnings: Source PDF tariff codes use no-dot 8-digit format (NNNNNNNN). All codes normalized to NNNN.NN.NN per project schema by inserting dots after positions 4 and 6. Subheading codes (e.g. '250100') normalized to NNNN.NN (e.g. '2501.00'); heading codes (e.g. '2501') preserved as 4 digits.

Chapter 25 opens Section V (Mineral Products). PDF page 1 carries the subtitle 'Section V, MINERAL PRODUCTS' but contains NO separate Section V Main Notes table — only Chapter 25 Main Notes (4 notes) and a Chapter 25 Supplementary Notes table (1 note). Therefore section_notes is empty for this chapter; Section V notes (if any exist at Schedule level) must be captured from the Section V cover page if/when extracted separately.
Supplementary Notes captured in top-level 'supplementary_notes' array (convention chosen for this chapter; not merged into chapter_notes).
Note 2 (the main exclusion note) lists sub-clauses (a) through (k) as a single verbatim block. Each sub-clause is extracted as a separate exclusion_clauses entry.

Note 2 sub-clause (h) contains OCR/spacing artifacts in the source PDF: 'magnesiumoxide' (magnesium oxide), 'ofsodiumchloride' (of sodium chloride). Preserved verbatim in source_note_text; normalized in excluded_product_text where needed for readability.
Note 2 sub-clause (k) contains an OCR artifact 'tailors? chalks' where '?' is a typographic apostrophe (intended: "tailors' chalks"). Preserved verbatim.
Note 4 contains OCR/spacing artifacts: 'meerschaumand' (meerschaum and), 'rods,sticks' (rods, sticks), 'orsimilar' (or similar). Preserved verbatim.

PDF table-chrome rows ('Main Notes', 'Supplementary Notes', 'Sl.No. Notes Notification Date Notification No', 'Product Description and Export Policy', 'Itc(hs) Code. Description Export Policy Policy Condition') were recognized as table headers and EXCLUDED from the legal notes per extraction rules.

Several headings in the PDF show a heading-level description row (4-digit code) followed by a subheading-level description row (6-digit code, e.g. '250100') that repeats/rephrases the heading description verbatim. The 6-digit row is the WCO international subheading description; preserved as the subheading title where present.

Heading 2527 is absent from the source PDF (the heading sequence jumps from 2526 to 2528). 2527 is reserved internationally (Natural cryolite; natural chiolite) but carries no tariff lines in the Indian Schedule 2 PDF for this chapter. Not included in headings array.

Subheading 2515.11 appears in the source as code '251511' but the PDF shows only the 8-digit tariff line '25151100' (Marble and travertine -- Crude or roughly trimmed) with no separate 6-digit subheading row. Subheading constructed from the 8-digit code; subheading title taken verbatim from the tariff line description. Same pattern for 2515.20 (split label row '251520' provides 'Ecaussine and other calcareous monumental or building stone;'), 2516.11, 2516.12, 2516.20, 2516.90 (label row '251690' present), 2517.10, 2517.20, 2517.30, 2517.41, 2517.49, 2518.10, 2518.20, 2519.10, 2519.90, 2520.10, 2520.20, 2521.00, 2522.10, 2522.20, 2522.30, 2523.10, 2523.21, 2523.29, 2523.30, 2523.90, 2524.10, 2524.90, 2525.10, 2525.20, 2525.30, 2526.10, 2526.20, 2528.00, 2529.10, 2529.21, 2529.22, 2529.30, 2530.10, 2530.20, 2530.90.

Heading 2502 has a single tariff line '25020000' (UNROASTED IRON PYRITES) with no separate 6-digit subheading row in the PDF. Modelled as subheading '2502.00' with title 'Unroasted iron pyrites.' (heading-level description, verbatim from heading row), with the single tariff line attached.
Heading 2509 has a single tariff line '25090000' (Chalk) with no separate 6-digit subheading row. Modelled as subheading '2509.00' with title 'Chalk'.
Heading 2514 has a single tariff line '25140000' (Slate, ...) with no separate 6-digit subheading row. Modelled as subheading '2514.00'.

Numeric inline expressions in the PDF render with no space: '85percent' (Note 4 / heading 2528), '97 percent' (heading 2529 fluorspar — space preserved in source), '1percent SiO2' (tariff 25210010), '2.5g each' (Note 2 (h)). Preserved verbatim.
Some heading titles in the PDF are rendered in ALL CAPS (e.g. headings 2503, 2507, 2512, 2518, 2521, 2528) while others are sentence case. Preserved verbatim per source.

Heading 2503 title in PDF reads 'SULPHUR OF ALL KINDS, OTHER THAN SUBLIMED SULPHUR, PRECIPITATED SULPHUR AND COLLODIAL SULPHUR'. The 6-digit row '250300' provides the sentence-case form 'Sulphur of all kinds, other than sublimed sulphur, precipitated sulphur and colloidal sulphur.' — note that the heading-level uppercase form has 'COLLODIAL' (likely typo) while the subheading form has 'colloidal'. Both preserved verbatim in their respective fields.

Tariff 25241010 (Crocidolite) carries Export Policy 'Free' with Policy Condition 'Export of Crocidolite is free subject to No Objection Certificate from the Department of Chemicals and Petro-Chemicals, Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers, New Delhi'. Captured in policy_conditions array.

Tariff lines 25085031, 25085032, 25085039 (Sillimanite) and 25132030 (Natural garnet) carry Export Policy 'STE (State Trading Enterprise)' with Policy Condition 'Export is allowed through Indian Rare Earths Limited (IREL) only.' Captured in policy_conditions array.

Tariff lines under subheading 2505.10 (Silica sands and quartz sands: 25051011, 25051012, 25051019, 25051020) and 2505.90 (25059000 Other) carry Export Policy 'Restricted'. Tariff 25309099 (Other: ---- Other under heading 2530) also 'Restricted'. Captured in policy_conditions array.
No 'unit' column appears in the source PDF for Chapter 25 tariff lines — units set to null throughout.

chapter_notes.text: Except where their context or Note 4 to this Chapter otherwise requires, the headings of this Chapter cover only products which are in the crude state or which have been washed (even with chemical substances eliminating the impurities without changing the structure ofthe product), crushed, ground, powdered, levigated, sifted, screened, concentrated by flotation, magnetic separation or other mechanical or physical processes (except crystallization), but not products that have been roasted, calcined, obtained by mixing or subjected to processing beyond that mentioned in each heading. The products of this Chapter may contain an added anti-dusting agent, provided that such addition does not render the product particularly suitable for specific use rather than for general use.

This Chapter does not cover : (a) sublimed sulphur, precipitated sulphur and colloidal sulphur (heading 2802); (b) earth colours containing 70% or more by weight of combined iron evaluated as Fe2O3 (heading 2821); (c) medicaments and other products of Chapter 30; (d) perfumery, cosmetic or toilet preparations (Chapter 33); (e) dolomite ramming mix (heading 3816); (f) setts, curbstones and flagstones (heading 6801); mosaic cubes or the like (heading 6802); roofing, facing or damp course slates (heading 6803); (g) precious or semi-precious stones (heading 7102 or 7103); (h) cultured crystals (other than optical elements) weighing not less than 2.5g each, of sodium chloride or of magnesiumoxide, of heading 3824; optical elements ofsodiumchloride or of magnesium oxide (heading 9001); (ij) billiard chalks (heading 9504); or (k) writing or drawing chalks and tailors? chalks (heading 9609).
Any products classifiable in heading 2517 and any other heading of this Chapter are to be classified in heading 2517.

Heading 2530 applies, inter alia, to : vermiculite, perlite and chlorites, unexpanded; earth colours, whether or not calcined or mixed together; natural micaceous iron oxides; meerschaum (whether or not in polished pieces); amber; agglomerated meerschaumand agglomerated amber, in plates, rods,sticks orsimilar forms, not worked after moulding; jet; strontianite (whether or not calcined), other than strontium oxide; broken pieces of pottery, brick or concrete.

supplementary_notes.text: In heading 2523, "sagol" means cement obtained by heating limestone and burnt coal in a kiln; and "ashmoh" means cement obtained by fine grinding of paddy husk, ash and hydrated lime with an additive.
